addr: 8th, 118, 2nd Cross, main Delmia Circle, JP Nagar 4th Phase, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

rev.t: We always visited Mk Ahmed for groceries shopping let me tell you here you will find all sorts of of collections all 3 floor are all the time full with so much new collections let it be a bday party shopping or grocery or stationary you get …

This supermarket has been good for several years, they have maintained good quality for years now and customer service is also commendable, one of the go to grocery store in JP nagar, they offer 3% discount on cash but nothing if you use Sodexho cards, overall good experience, they have space for few cars next to the store.
Great assortment of products with many imported brands available. The products seem to be organised well and I found all that I was looking for easily. …
